(551)thams cad mkhyon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/mdzod gnas drug pa'i lam dang gang zag bstan pa'i skabs kyi gang zag gi dbaye ba rgyas par bshad pa lam lnga las/gtso bo 'a

tei:div.tei:p: (551)thams cad mkhyon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ mdzod gnas drug pa'i lam dang gang zag bstan pa'i skabs kyi gang zag gi dbaye ba rgyas par bshad pa lam lnga las/ gtso bo 'phags lam gyi dbaye ba dge 'dun nyi shu las/ dang po/ mthong lam la rgyun zhugs la zhugs pa dag 'bras nas gnyis kyi dang po la dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis mthong lam gi sngon rol gyi dbang du byas nasi na gyi mthong lam ni mngon sum du 'dra ba'i phyir zhes slob dpon gang spel gyis gsung la/ de la zhug pa ni/ lam la phyes na mthong lam skad cig bco lnga*/ 'dod chags dang bral bas drug ste dadodo na gcig kyang ma spang ba dang gcig nas lnga'i bar spang ba'i drug go dper na 'di ltar bsgyur bas dgu bcu de rigs kyi nyams pa'i chos can sogs lngas bsgyur bas bzhi brgya dang lnga bcur 'gyur la (552)de dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsu gyis bsgyur bas stong sum brgya lnga bcur 'gyur la/ de rten gyis gling gsum gyis mi gsum 'dod lha drug ste dgus bsgyur bas cig khri nyis stong brgyad rtsa lnga bcu shar ba dang*/ mchim mdzod kyi mtshan khri nyis stong bdun brgya lnga bcu bris pa dang mi mthun pas dpyad dgos/ de bzhin du dbang rnon chos kyi rajes 'brang la rigs la dbye ba med pas lam gyi bco lnga spang ba drug gis bsgyur bas dgu dbang po gsum gyis bsgyur bas nyis brgya bdun bcu/ de rten gyis dgus bsgyur bas nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu tham par 'gyur ro/ 'bras gnas dad mos la lam gyi dbye ba med pas tams cad bcu drug par zad do gsang pas bcu drug pa la spag ba gis bsgyur na gcig bsgahayur mang nyung med pas drug la rigs lngas bsgyur bas drug lnga sum bcu tham pa/ de dbang sos gsu gyis bsgyur bas dgu de rten gyis dgus bsgyur bas brgyad brgya dang bcu (553)mthong thob lam la gcig spang ba drug gis bsgyur bas gcig bsgyur mang nyung med pas drug

de la rigs kyi dbye ba med pas dbang po gsu gyis bsgyur bas drug gsum bco brgyad/ de rten gyi dgus bsgyur bas brgya rtsa dang drug cu re gnyis yod/ de ltar rgyun zhugs pa la da mos mthong thob gnyis/ 'bras gnas la tsam po ba dang khyad par ba gnyis/ khyad par ba la lha mi'i rigs skyes gnyis dang lnga'o/ gnyis pa chags bral sngon 'gro'i phyir 'ong la zhugs 'bras gnyis las zhugs pa la'ang gnyis las/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang ni rgyun zhugs rgyun zhugs dad pa'i rjes 'brang ltar/ de ni dang po lam la bden bzhi dang chos shes rjes shes gnyis te lam la drug de 'dod chags dang bral bas drug gis bsgyur bas drug drug sum cu po drug de rigs kyi lnga*/ dbang pos gsum/ rten gyis gsu bsgyur bas bzhi stong brgyad brgya drug cu'o (554)chos gyi rjes 'brag ni/ lam la drug 'dod chags dang bral ba'i drug gis bsgyur bas sum cu so drug rigs kyi dbye ba med pas/ dbang pos gsum gyis bsgyur bas brgya dang brgyad/ 'di la rten gyi dgus bsgyur dgu brgya bdun cu don gnyis 'ong*/ yang na/ lam la bden bzhi dang chos rjes shes gnyis te drug la/ khams gyis bcu drug gis bsgyur la/ de dbang po gsum gyas bsgyur la/ de la rten gyis dgus bsgyur bas stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis su 'gyur ro/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas dad pa'i rjes 'brang*/ lam la drug 'dod chags dang bral bas gsum gyis bsgyur/ de rten gyis dgus bsgyur bas bzhi brgya dang gya drug tu 'gyur ro/ phyir 'onga'abras gnas mthong thob ni/ lam la dbye ba med pas lam gcig la/ 'dod chags dang bral bas gsum gyis bsgyur/ de dbang pos gsum dang*/ de rten gyis dgus bsgyur bas brgyad cu rtsa gcig go de ltar na phyir 'ong la gsum (555)zhugs pa gnyis zhugs pa gcig tu brtsis/ 'bras gnas la tsam po ba dang*/

khyad par ba tshe bar chad gcig pa'i khyad par ba dang gsum mo/ gsum pa chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'og ni 'dod nyon skor dgu po spang ba'i lam rjes sais la gnas pa'i tshe phyir mi 'ong zhugs par 'gyur te rgyal po'i sras 'grel bshad don gsal las rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang phyir 'ong 'bras gnas phyir mi 'ong zhugs par gsung bas/ de ltar na lam la bcu drug 'dod chags dang bral bas drug cu re bzhi ste/ bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med dang po gsum gyi spang bya dgu re la gnas bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med dang po gsum ste bdun gyis bsgyur bas dgu bdun drug cu re gsum la 'dod lapa'i chung du spang ba'am/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'ching ba mtha' dag gang rung gcig bsnan te re bzhi/ de la rigs lnga*/ dbang pos gsum/ rten gyis dgus (556)bsgyur bas 'bum nyi khri dgu stong drug brgya yod par gsung*/ chos kyi rjes 'brang la rigs kyi dbye ba med pas gzhan de dang 'dra ste nyi khri lnga stong dgu brgya nya shu yod do/ gnas pa la bye brag mang kyang gzhung gis gsal bas ma bris so/ gang spel 'grel ba mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brag ba las/ phyir mi 'ong dang*/ dgra bcom gyi srid rtse'i gnen po rdo rje lta bu'i dbye ba gnyis mdzad nas gzhan rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong gnyis ci rigs par brtsi 'o gsung ba las dbye ba mdzad gsung*/ dbyig gnen rang 'grel las/ lam dang*/ spang ba dang*/ rigs dang dbang po/ rten gyi sgo nas ci rigs par brtsi'o/ de ltar ma yin na mi 'dra ba brtsis par 'gyur ro/ gsung nas dbye ba'i sgo tsam las ma gsung*/ phyogs glang gis 'brel bar zhib tu brtsis mi snang*/ des na gang spel gyis 'grel bar/ phyir mi 'ong ba la/ bsam gtan bzhi las/ dang po tshang ris la rigs kyi sgo nas nyams pa'i chos can sogs drug (557)tshan la/ spang bya sgom spang dgu re bye bas dgu tshan drug ste/

gcig tu sdom na dgu drug nga bzhir 'gyur la de tshangs chen ma gtogs pa'i gsan ris bcu drug gis bsgyur ba lnga bcu nga bzhi tshan pa bcu dragu po gcig tu sdom na brgyad brgya drug cu re bzhir 'gyur la/ de dbang po'i bye brag gis sum 'gyur byas na bar ma dor mya ngan las 'da' ba nyis stong lnga brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur la/ bar 'da' de bzhin skye 'da' mngon par 'du byed dang bcas pa dang*/ 'du byed med pa dang*/ gong 'apo bzi la de ltar brtsis pas thams cad sdom na phyir mi 'ong ba khri nyis stong dgu brgya drug cu tham pa yin no/ ji skad bshad pa 'dis phyir mi 'ong gzugs med par nyer 'gro bar 'da' ma gtogs pa rnams kyi dbye ba khong du chud par bya'o/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i nyes cha gu spang ba gzugs med du nyer 'gro dang*/ srid rtse'i nyes cha brgyad zad pa dgra bcom zhugs pa'o (558)gsungs so/ de ltar phyir mi 'ong ba 'di la bcu/ zhugs pa gcig 'bras gnas la dgu bar 'da'/ skye 'da'/ byed bcas/ byed med/ gong 'pho la 'phar ba/ phyed 'phar/ thams cad 'phar ba gsum/ srid rtser 'gro ba gzugs kaya chags bcom tshe 'di la 'da' ba mthong chos zhi/ 'gogs snyoms lus mngon byed gnyis dang dgu'o/ bzhi dang dgra bcom pa zhugs pa ni srid rtse'i nyes cha brgyad kyi bar zad pa la brtson pa yin no/ dgu pa bar chad med pa'i lame ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yin te/ khams gsu gyi phra rgyas lhag ma ma lus pa 'jom par nus pa'i phyir ro/ rdor ting de la dbye na pa'i sgo nas dgu ste/ bsam gtan sa drug dang*/ gzugs med dang so gsum la brten pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhi ste bden bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ rnam pa'i sgo nas bcu drug ste mi rtag sogs bcu drag la dmakigs pa'i phyir/ de ltar dbye na ni shin tu mang (559)ste mi lcogs med pa la brten pa'i rdor ting la srid rtse'i kho no'i sdug kun gnyis la dmigs pa'i brgyad/

sa thams cad kyi 'gogs pa la migs pa'i rnam pa so drug lam la dmigs pa brgyad ste rdor ting bcu dang gnyis/ de bzhin pa lhag ma lnga la 'gres so/ gzugs med dang po gsu gyis bsdus pa rim pa bzhin nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang rtsa bzhi dang nyi shu yin te/ 'dod pa'i lam dang sa 'og ma'i 'gogs pa la'ang mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ de ltar bsam gtan sa drug thams cad ldom na sum brgya bcu gnyis dang*/ gzugs med dang po gsum sdom na bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ de thams cad ldom na sum brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur la/ de dag rigs kyis drug dang*/ dbang po gsum gyis bsgyur na drug stong dgu brgya bcu gnyis su gyur ro/ yang lam bden yang 'gogs bden dang 'dra bar sa re re dmigs par 'dod pa'i lugs ltar na gong ma'i lam spyi la (560)dmigs pa'i rjes shes bzhi mi 'byung bas sa dgu'i lam bden lad migs pa'i chos shes bzhi dang rjes shes sum cu rtsa gnyis te dgu drug sum cu po drug 'gogs pa'i so drug gnyis sdom na don gnyis/ sdug kun gnyis kyi brgyad bsnyan pas brgyad cu po sa drug po re re la brgyad cu brgyad cu bsdom pas bzhi brgya dang brgyad cu dang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang nyer bzhi yin pas dgu bcu rtsa drug tu 'gyur bas thams cad sdom na lnga brgya dang bdun cu rtsa drug tu 'gyur la de dag snga ma ltar/ rigs kyi drug dang*/ dbang pos gsum gyis bsgyur na rdo rje lta bu khri sum brgya drug cu rtsa brgyad du 'gyur ro/ gnyis pa 'bras gnas srid rtse'i dgu pa spang ba'i gcig de rigs kyi lngar/ dbang pos gsum/ rten gyi nyer dgu'i bsgyur bas bzhi brgya su cu po bdun yod/ dus mi sbyor (561)na rigs kyi dbye ba med pas/ dbang po dang rten gh+yis bsgyur bas brgyad cu gya bdun no/ shes rab gyi cha las rnam grol la rnam grol gyi lam gcig la dbang pos gsum/

rigs gyi drug rten gyis nyer dgus bsgyur bas lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis po/ gnyis ka'i cha las grol ba'ang*/ de bzhin no/ 'di'i rten nyer dgu ni 'dod pa'i dgu/ gzugs kyi bcu drag gzugs med dang po gsum/ nu chung dang nyer dgu yin/ mthong chos zhi sogs kya dbye ba rnams gzhung mchan gyis gsal/ de ltar dgra bco zhugs pa dang*/ rang rgyal gnyis te nyi shu'o/ nyi shu brtsi tshul gzhan yod do/ mngon pa'i chos la yid mos pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos rang gi brjed byang du bris pa'o/ ༄༅// sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i btsun ma la gdams pa/ snying nas chos la 'bad pa la/ dang po blo ldog rnam pa bzhi'i blo yang yang ma sbyongan/ lta ba'i mtho snyabs (562)byed pa'i deng sang gi chos gzugs don med tshe 'di ba gcig rgyu 'gro nyan che/ dkon mchog gsum la yid ches pa'i dad pas mi bslu bar shes pa'i sgo nas thun re re bzhin skyabs 'gro mgo ma thog na phyi nang gi khyad par ma phyed pas 'di chos kyi rtsa ba yin/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems rgyud la ma skyes na ci byed rang don du 'gro bas ming theg pa chen po btags kyang thar pa'am tshe 'di bar cha/ bsags sbyong gi sgo du ma nas sgribs sbyangs dang tshogs bsags ma byas na dngos grub 'dod pa nam mkha'i me tog gi dpe ltar song nas dngos grub 'di phyi gnyis kar mi thob/ bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa'i man ngag gnad du ma basbun na kha tsam tshig tsam gyis gsol 'debs dang mos gus yod mdog gi rang sems bslu ba mang bas bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi mos gus kyis gsol 'debs thang lho med pa dgos/ rang sems gnyugs ma'i don ma mthong na sems gnas u tshug gi glen sgom gar 'khyog mi shes pas blo sbyong dang nyams bsra bsre gyas chos nges lkog thub pa re dgos lags/
